About us

Shilpa Advisors

CEO & Founder

Shilpa Advisors is a Sri Lanka-based team of consultants, trainers, and HR tech practitioners. We translate standards into simple tools and automated workflows so SMEs scale without chaos—HRMS Sri Lanka, ISO consulting Sri Lanka, Training & OBT Kitulgala, Private Security SOPs.

Our Vision

Sri Lanka’s most trusted SME partner for turning standards into everyday practice—clarity, compliance, confidence at every site.

Our Mission

Simplify compliance · Automate the boring · Build capability · Measure what matters.

Why SMEs pick us

Compliance that works

SOPs and HR/Payroll flows people actually use—no binder theatre.

Customisable HRMS

OT slabs, multi-level approvals, bilingual payslips, bank files, report packs.

Audit-day calm

Internal audits, rehearsals, and surveillance readiness.

What we do

One partner for growth-ready compliance in Sri Lanka: HRMS that fits your rules, ISO systems that pass audits, training that changes behaviour, and security operations that win client confidence. Simple plans, fast rollouts, clean evidence.

HRMS Sri Lanka

Payroll (EPF/ETF/APIT & stamp duty), biometric attendance, leave, bilingual payslips, bank files—customisable.

ISO consulting Sri Lanka

Gap → Docs → Training → Internal Audits → Certification (9001/45001/22000/14001/21001; HACCP/GMP)

Training & OBT (Kitulgala)

Leadership/supervisory (EN/SI/TA), ISO awareness/IA, OHS 45001; experiential offsites.

Private Security SOPs

Guard-force SOPs, induction/refresher training, incident playbooks, surprise audits; ISO 18788 alignment.

Meet The Founders

Shilpa Advisors

Shilpa Advisors
CO-FOUNDER

Aruna Maganaarachchi is at the helm of Shilpa Advisors Pvt Ltd. Aruna is a retired Commander of the Sri Lanka Navy and also with over two decades of working experience in the private sector. Aruna had his education at Wesley College and the Royal College of Colombo before joining SL Navy. He retired from the military services with battle casualties in late 2001. With the qualifications of Human Resources Management, Marketing Management and Quality Assurance he held several managerial positions in leading business enterprises in Sri Lanka for over twenty-four years. Further, he holds an MBA and presently reading for the DBA. With the experience and knowledge gained through the working experience and the observations made during the travels island-wide “Shilpa Advisors” was formed with the intention of uplifting the Sri Lankan Small and Medium Enterprises of different sectors. Aruna will personally attend to your needs with frequent site visits and consultations. He will be with you from the GAP Analysis - Training & Records maintenance - Audits - Certification - Continuation of Certification
